description: MainActivity.kt: Defines the main activity for a Tic Tac Toe game built with Android Views, managing game state, UI, and user interactions without Compose.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class that manages the user interface and game logic for Tic Tac Toe game.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the UI components, sets up game board, and defines button actions.

methods.name: onCellClicked
methods.description: Handles user interaction when a cell is clicked, updates game state, and checks for win/draw.

methods.name: togglePlayer
methods.description: Switches the current player between 'X' and 'O'.

methods.name: disableBoard
methods.description: Disables all cells to prevent further input after game over.

methods.name: enableBoard
methods.description: Enables all cells to allow new input when starting or resetting the game.

methods.name: updateScore
methods.description: Updates the displayed score based on current win counts.

methods.name: resetBoard
methods.description: Resets the game board, optionally resetting scores based on parameter.

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Evaluates the game board to determine if there is a winner, draw, or ongoing.

methods.name: dp
methods.description: Utility function to convert dp units to pixels.
